title: Implement a TTL cache in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement a TtlCache that stores key-value pairs with per-entry expiry tracked by insertion order, supporting get (returns None if expired), insert, and remove_expired.

required_artifacts: insert stores Entry with expires_at = ttl argument
get returns None if now >= expires_at
get returns None for missing keys
remove_expired evicts all entries with expires_at <= now
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
